5404.title: Launcher continues startup after detecting a live runtime owner
5404.rootCauseOneLine: A rejected runtime-record claim only warns; startup still spawns a server against the occupied local port and shared store.
5404.proposedFix: Return before spawning when another live runtime owns the data directory and the configured local health endpoint is healthy; preserve exit status 1 and unhealthy-owner fallback.
5404.caveats: No macOS performance, service-manager cadence, concurrent claim races, or resulting recovery damage was tested. Complete reproduction code and results are inline in the report.
